name: All In One Login Page Styling and Custom Login Security – Temporary Login – Passwordless Login temporary Access – Login History – Login Log – Block Ip and  Country from accessing login – Force Logout – Chage Logo – Change login addresss
author: Zia Imtiaz

sections.description:
Easy to use Custom Login Page. Customize Login design, add extra security and control, activity log user login history , failed attempts, and block IPs and regions from accessing login.

With All In One Custom Login Page Styler and Admin Login Solutions, you can:
* Personalize your login page with custom branding, logos, background images, and colors With Live Preview.
* Secure your login with Math Captcha, Google reCAPTCHA, IP blocking, and region restrictions.
* Track user activity with detailed login logs and failed attempt logging.
* Limit login attempts to prevent brute-force attacks.
* Add Custom Login Menu.
* Change User Login Redirects After Login and Logout.
* Change Admin Login Url

Features

  • Login Customization: Easily style your login page, changing elements like the logo, background, form, input fields, and buttons for a consistent and branded experience.
  • Google reCAPTCHA: Prevent spam and unauthorized login attempts with Google reCAPTCHA integration. Simply enter your Site Key and Secret Key.
  • Temporary Login URL: Generate single-use admin access URLs that expire automatically after 7 days, or a custom duration if specified.
  • Login Logs: View detailed login record of user login activity, including last seen time, IP address, user role, and location.
  • Force Logout: From Login logs admin can force logout othe user with just one click .
  • IP and Region Blocking: Block access to the login page from specific IP addresses or regions for enhanced security.
  • Limit Login Attempts: Control login attempts per IP address to reduce brute-force attempts.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/all-in-one-custom-login-page-styler directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to “Settings” to configure the plugin options as per your preferences.
sections.faq:
How do I customize the login page?

Go to the plugin settings and choose the Login Customization section to update your login page elements, such as the logo, background, and button styles.

How can I enable Google reCAPTCHA on my login page?

In the Google reCAPTCHA section of the settings, enter your Site Key and Secret Key. These keys can be obtained from the Google reCAPTCHA site.

Can I restrict login access to specific regions or IP addresses?

Yes, you can block access from specific IP addresses or choose regions to block from the IP and Region Blocking section in the settings.

How do I track user login activity?

Under Login Logs, you can view detailed logs, including login time, IP address, user role, and location.

What happens when the login attempt limit is reached?

If a user exceeds the allowed number of login attempts, they will be temporarily locked out, helping to prevent unauthorized access.
